title: Witness v1 — an append-only signature or ratification
description: Witnesses sit OUTSIDE the signed body. ratified_at derives from the accepted witness and its time source; it is never authored on the act.

key_id.description: A verifier must establish whether this key was valid WHEN THE SIGNATURE WAS MADE. A signature without historical key status proves only that some key signed some bytes.

time_source.description: Required. A timestamp with no named authority cannot be replayed.
